This is a list of the world's countries and their dependencies, ranked by total area, including land and water.

This list includes entries that are not limited to those in the _____ standard, which covers [[:Category:Countries|sovereign states]] and dependent territories. All 193 Countries of the. Largely unrecognised states not in are included in the list in ranked order. The areas of such largely unrecognised states are in most cases also included in the areas of the more widely recognised states that claim the same territory; see the notes in the "Notes" column for each country for clarification.

* '''Total area:''' the sum of land and water areas within international boundaries and coastlines.
